text: The Gemini Notebook API is a REST interface for programmatically creating and managing notebooks and sources in Gemini Notebook. Ingest web pages, YouTube videos, plain text, and Markdown into persistent notebooks. Just want to get started? Go to the Quickstart , copy the setup prompt, and give it to your coding agent. import requests API = "https://notebook.googleapis.com/v1" headers = { "Authorization" : f "Bearer { ACCESS_TOKEN } " , "x-goog-user-project" : PROJECT_ID , "Content-Type" : "application/json" , } # 1. Create a notebook nb = requests . post ( f " { API } /notebooks" , headers = headers , json = { "display_name" : "My Research" }) . json () # 2. Add a source requests . post ( f " { API } / { nb [ 'name' ] } /sources" , headers = headers , json = { "display_name" : "Gemini API Guide" , "web_content" : { "url" : "https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs" } }) JavaScript const API = "https://notebook.googleapis.com/v1" ; const headers = { "Authorization" : `Bearer ${ ACCESS_TOKEN } ` , "x-goog-user-project" : PROJECT_ID , "Content-Type" : "application/json" }; // 1. Create a notebook const nb = await ( await fetch ( ` ${ API } /notebooks` , { method : "POST" , headers , body : JSON . stringify ({ display_name : "My Research" }) })). json (); // 2. Add a source await fetch ( ` ${ API } / ${ nb . name } /sources` , { method : "POST" , headers , body : JSON . stringify ({ display_name : "Gemini API Guide" , web_content : { url : "https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs" } }) }); REST # 1. Create a notebook NOTEBOOK = $( curl -s -X POST "https://notebook.googleapis.com/v1/notebooks" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN " \ -H "x-goog-user-project: $PROJECT_ID " \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"display_name": "My Research"}' ) NOTEBOOK_NAME = $( echo " $NOTEBOOK " | python3 -c "import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['name'])" ) # 2. Add a source curl -s -X POST "https://notebook.googleapis.com/v1/ ${ NOTEBOOK_NAME } /sources" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN " \ -H "x-goog-user-project: $PROJECT_ID " \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "display_name": "Gemini API Guide", "web_content": {"url": "https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs"} }' Guides and resources REST API reference inventory_2 Notebooks Create, list, and update notebooks. web Sources Add web pages, YouTube videos, plain text, or Markdown to a notebook. hub Model Context Protocol (MCP) Connect AI coding agents and IDEs to the remote Gemini Notebook MCP server. key Authentication Configure OAuth 2.0 access tokens and scopes for API requests. speed Rate limits and quotas Review request rate limits, per-source word limits, and tier capacity. map Roadmap See items on the Gemini Notebook API roadmap.
